body_markdown:
Logitech has once again earned recognition from the prestigious **[Red Dot Design Awards](https://www.red-dot.org/search)** , winning four awards across multiple categories. A renowned panel of industry experts evaluates the Red Dot Awards to highlight the best in quality, function, and innovation. These accolades reflect Logitech’s dedication to design-led software-enabled hardware. This year’s group of winning products features the following:


- **Rally Camera Streamline Kit** – It incorporates world-class Logitech optics, a 4K sensor, and wireless preset buttons in a sleek industrial design.


- **MX Ink** – The first mixed-reality stylus designed for Meta Quest that bridges 2D and 3D creation for immersive experiences with pressure-sensitive control.


- **G325 LIGHTSPEED Wireless Gaming Headset** – Its ultra-lightweight materials deliver weightless, pressure-free comfort for all-day focus and effortless control.


- **PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE** – Engineered with Haptic Inductive Trigger System (HITS) technology, the hardware design delivers faster, fully customizable clicks with instant tactile feedback for maximum competitive speed and durability.


“Great design balances craft, creativity and constraints, and a deep understanding of users,” said Malin Leschly, Chief Design Officer at Logitech. “We’re proud to see these four products recognized by Red Dot for thoughtful design and for finding new ways to improve how people work and play.”
